create_masked_mse_loss: create a MaskedMSE criterion instance to compute masked mean squared error loss for CroCo training
compute_masked_mse_with_normalization: compute masked MSE loss with per-patch pixel normalization enabled for normalized target patches
compute_unmasked_mse_loss: compute mean squared error loss over all patches by setting masked to False
review_masked_mse_forward: review the MaskedMSE forward method to understand how masked patch loss is computed
test_masked_mse_criterion: test the MaskedMSE criterion with sample prediction, mask, and target tensors
